hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Track prefix sums modulo divisor d by recording remainder frequencies.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Subarrays whose sum is divisible by d correspond to matching prefix remainder pairs.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Count all occurrences of matching remainders in linear time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

def countValidSubarraysWithMatchingDigits(nums: list[int], d: int) -> int:
    rem_counts = defaultdict(int)
    rem_counts[0] = 1
    cur_sum = 0
    ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        cur_sum = (cur_sum + x) % d
        ans += rem_counts[cur_sum]
        rem_counts[cur_sum] += 1
    return ans
```
